verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents posting a chatMessage into a channel via the official API (ms-teams-docs-11/21), and the live Graph endpoint is OAuth-gated (probe-5/6), confirming scoped-token access for automation of Teams channels/conversations (docs-8/9/10). However, there's no explicit documentation cited for reading channel messages (only export/posting is shown) nor a concrete listing of the specific scoped permissions required, so the 'read' half of the story is thinner. Missing for 10: explicit GET/read-channel-messages API documentation, explicit OAuth scope list for channel read/post, independent hands-on confirmation of an agent successfully reading+posting via scoped token.
